# Files of the rs2 boot volume (paths relative to the repository root).
# Programs built from userland/ are added by xtask (among them OS2\E.EXE,
# the System Editor, from userland/e, and its help OS2\HELP\E.HLP compiled
# from userland/e/E.IPF), the system message files (OS2\SYSTEM\OSO001.MSG
# and the others, from userland/msg) and the help books (OS2\HELP\WPHELP.HLP,
# OS2\BOOK\CMDREF.INF and START.INF, from userland/help), and the SOM
# interface repositories OS2\ETC\SOM.IR, WPSH.IR, WPDSERV.IR and REXX.IR
# (written from userland/somir/*-ir.txt, which tools/scripts/gen_som_ir.py
# makes from the IDL of SOM's, the Workplace Shell's and Object REXX's
# classes).
dist/CONFIG.SYS -> CONFIG.SYS
dist/README.TXT -> README.TXT
# Separator pages for printers (docs/PRINTING.md): text and PostScript.
dist/spool/SAMPLE.SEP -> OS2\SAMPLE.SEP
dist/spool/PSCRIPT.SEP -> OS2\PSCRIPT.SEP
dist/etc/HOSTS -> MPTN\ETC\HOSTS
dist/etc/SERVICES -> MPTN\ETC\SERVICES
dist/etc/PROTOCOL -> MPTN\ETC\PROTOCOL
dist/etc/NETWORKS -> MPTN\ETC\NETWORKS
dist/etc/RPC -> MPTN\ETC\RPC
dist/etc/LMHOSTS -> MPTN\ETC\LMHOSTS
# The LAN requester's settings (docs/LAN.md).
dist/ibmlan/IBMLAN.INI -> IBMLAN\IBMLAN.INI
# The Liberation fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1, PSFONTS\LIBERATN.TXT):
# PMWIN's system font and the Helvetica, Times New Roman and Courier faces.
dist/fonts/LIBSANS.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBSANS.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBSANSB.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBSANSB.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBSANSI.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBSANSI.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBSANBI.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBSANBI.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBSERIF.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBSERIF.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBSERFB.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBSERFB.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBSERFI.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBSERFI.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBSRFBI.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBSRFBI.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBMONO.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBMONO.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBMONOB.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBMONOB.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBMONOI.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBMONOI.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBMONBI.TTF -> PSFONTS\LIBMONBI.TTF
dist/fonts/LIBERATN.TXT -> PSFONTS\LIBERATN.TXT
# REXX: REXXTRY (rs2's own); REXX.DLL, REXXAPI.DLL, REXXUTIL.DLL, REX.MSG
# and REXH.MSG are built from userland/ (docs/REXX.md).
userland/rexx/REXXTRY.CMD -> OS2\REXXTRY.CMD
# Object REXX (OREXX.DLL, OREXUTIL.DLL, OREXXSOM.DLL, OREXXWPS.DLL, REXXC.EXE,
# OREX.MSG and OREXH.MSG are built from userland/): SWITCHRX.CMD makes it
# the system's REXX, WPSINST.CMD registers its Workplace Shell classes.
userland/rexx/SWITCHRX.CMD -> OS2\SWITCHRX.CMD
userland/rexx/WPSINST.CMD -> OS2\WPSINST.CMD
# OpenDoc: OS2\DLL\OPENDOC.DLL (rs2 runtime, docs/OPENDOC.md) is built
# from userland/opendoc.
